title: Palimpsity - River Pact
description: Found two districts, choose between garden commons and makers quarters, and prepare for a forecast drought. Start River Pact in the side panel; advance five turns at a time or use the usual speed controls. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement.
controls: Click: build or inspect. Drag: rotate. Right-drag: pan. Scroll: zoom.
R: rotate a building. Escape: cancel. Space: pause or resume.
Arrow keys and Enter: choose a tile and build or inspect.
English / Français: switch language without restarting.
Start River Pact: a fresh three-act scenario. Choose a charter after Act I, then keep both districts supplied through the drought on turns 120-149.
Advance 5 turns: run up to five real simulation turns and pause; stops at a choice or result. Pauses are free. Hiding the tab pauses; resume manually.
First Neighbourhood starts the earlier challenge (24 residents, 8 healthy turns, deadline 120). Classic city returns to a fresh original game.
